headline: HOU @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.90 at LAA 4.45, with a projected total of 8.35. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: HOU moved -0.59 runs while LAA moved +0.47, changing the projected margin by -1.07 runs. NRFI probability rose +8.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Walbert Ureña has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jeremy Peña, Isaac Paredes, Oswald Peraza, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Mike Trout, Collin Price because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
